meta_description: 1,077 likes, 26 comments - lonelyplanet on October 27, 2026: "Matcha fans – add this small Japanese town, known as "the matcha capital of the world" for producing premium green tea, offering matcha workshops and more, to your itinerary. "You can go from sipping tea at a teahouse founded in 1160 to literally grinding your own leaves into powder," says Lonely Planet Correspondent @jesseogn. Uji is around 20 minutes from Kyoto by train and is worth a true half-day trip "rather than just a stop on the way somewhere else," he says.".
